abstract: McKinsey's 2024 survey reveals rapid AI adoption acceleration across organizations, with 72% now using AI in at least one function, up from 55% the previous year. Generative AI adoption specifically doubled during this period, indicating a significant shift in enterprise AI implementation patterns.
keyFindings: 72% of surveyed organizations use AI in at least one function, representing a 17 percentage point increase from 55% the prior year
Generative AI adoption doubled year-over-year among surveyed organizations
methodology: Survey of organizations on AI adoption rates. Specific sample size, sampling methodology, geographic scope, and survey period not specified in excerpt.
